title: AnalyticsChatCoworkUnifiedSessionsMetrics

action_count.title: Action Count
action_count.description: Same measure as `cowork_metrics.action_count`, for activity recorded while members had Chat and Cowork unified turned on.

artifacts_created_count.title: Artifacts Created Count
artifacts_created_count.description: Same measure as `cowork_metrics.artifacts_created_count`, for activity recorded while members had Chat and Cowork unified turned on. Exact in date-range mode: a creation belongs to exactly one day, so the per-day counts never overlap and their sum over the window is the exact count of distinct creations in it.

Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.
